en.title: Federal Funding Boosts Rail Accessibility as AI Tools Expand Disability Support
en.summary: The Federal Transit Administration has allocated $233 million to upgrade rail infrastructure nationwide, aiming to bring stations and vehicles into full compliance with disability access standards. Meanwhile, an AI‑assisted accessibility tool and a new digital ratings system are being released to help users and home‑care providers improve accessibility and safety. Additional reports highlight the need for AI guidelines in the arts sector and examine the historical impact of Christian nationalism on disability rights.

highlights.title: FTA issues $233M for rail accessibility upgrades
This incredible accessibility tool was coded with help from AI, and you can try it here
Digital ratings system helps improve safety, accessibility in home care settings
Christian Nationalism and Disability: A History of Harm
Arts organizations need AI guidelines to balance accessibility benefits with creative concerns

zh-TW.title: 聯邦撥款 推動 鐵路 無障礙 AI 工具 新突破
zh-TW.summary: 聯邦交通管理局撥款2.33億美元，用於全國鐵路無障礙升級，確保車站與列車符合殘障人士的無障礙標準。同時，AI 協助的無障礙工具與新數字評等系統已推出，協助使用者與居家護理機構提升無障礙與安全性。其他報導呼籲藝術組織制定 AI 指引，並檢視基督教民族主義對殘障權益的歷史影響。

highlights.title: 聯邦交通管理局撥款2.33億美元用於鐵路無障礙升級

數字評等系統有助於提升居家護理環境的安全與無障礙
